[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Kerch Kushi/Legends|Kerch Kushi]] was a member of a [[Near-Human]] '''[[Species/Legends|species]]''' with [[Color/Legends|blue]] skin, red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and teal [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> They inhabited [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]],<ref name="An Old Friend">{{TCW|An Old Friend}}</ref> [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]],<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> and [[Zardossa Stix/Legends|Zardossa Stix]],<ref name="The Disappeared">{{TCW|The Disappeared, Part II}}</ref> and many, including Kushi, were members of the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]].<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />
